title: Lux Modern Home | Free Parking | 9 min to Broadway
description:
Escape to our big house, where comfort meets luxury, nestled in the heart of East Nashville! Ideal for work stays, bach parties, and gatherings with friends, this house offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. With spacious living areas and multiple bedrooms, there's plenty of room for everyone to spread out. You'll have easy access to the area's top attractions,  trendy restaurants and shops. Downtown is a short drive away where you can experience all Music City has to offer.

The space
Locally owned and operated! Come stay with us and enjoy a stylish & modern experience at our centrally located three story home in the heart of East Nashville. Brand new and minutes from Downtown as well as local favorite Nashville restaurants, breweries and other hot spots.

- Queen bunk beds on 1st floor
- Guest room with 4 twin bunks 3rd floor
- Master with a king bed 3rd floor
- Rollaway beds for additional sleeping (2)
- Driveway parking available for up to 4 cars

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire home including private driveway.
